euclid.memory_database.assessment_basis: TRANSFER_VERIFIED only when a durable record observably biased candidate scoring (memory-influence transition); otherwise PERSISTED once the sqlite store wrote durably and verify() passes; restart verification is self-certified (no verify() on boot)

euclid.objective_controller.assessment_basis: derived objectives are applied to planning_goal and passed to the rank evaluator's context

euclid.representation_controller.assessment_basis: accepted restructuring changes representation consumed downstream

euclid.strategy_meta_learning.assessment_basis: a strategy/executed-arm update banks the outcome under a key the selection machinery reads (select_strategy or composer scoring)

euclid.v16.primitives.assessment_basis: primitives change the decision only when a primitive candidate was the executed action; composed-but-not-executed is used

euclid.v16.search.assessment_basis: v16 search changes the decision only when a search candidate was the executed action; composed-but-not-executed is used

experience_superlearner.assessment_basis: observe() runs only for reward-bearing experiences

pythia.memory.assessment_basis: the durable cognition memory adapter writes episode records into the sqlite store covered by verify()

pythia.store.assessment_basis: store.record_run appends journal rows only when a reward-bearing experience flows

repository.engineer.assessment_basis: governed executor ran and the observation was recorded

toe.meta_reasoning.assessment_basis: non-continue metacontrol actions are applied: replan rewrites the plan, halt_stalled ends the episode early

toe.planning.assessment_basis: CHANGES_DECISION requires a replan or an executed plan-node candidate; a plan composed but never consumed only ran

toe.world_model.assessment_basis: compare phase ran; world model updated from observed outcome (TOEWorldModelAdapter holds state in memory, not persisted)

note: assessed_stage is the highest stage supported by executable episode evidence; every grant rule requires the episode transition it records
